We need retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999 (we can't check price but assume buyable). Target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. So structure: para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to phenyl with trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (para-aminophenyl). So we can think disconnection: break sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride + aniline? Actually sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride and aniline. So step1: target -> sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) + aniline (para-methyl phenyl amine). The sulfonyl chloride is Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1. The other fragment is the rest: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached via sulfonamide N. Actually the sulfonamide nitrogen attached to phenyl sulfonyl chloride and to the other aryl group (the second phenyl). So disconnection: sulfonamide formation between aniline (para-methyl phenyl amine) and sulfonyl chloride (para-methyl phenyl sulfonyl chloride)?? Wait the sulfonyl chloride would be attached to the second phenyl? Actually the sulfonyl group is attached to the second phenyl (c2ccc...). The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to that phenyl and to the first phenyl (with methyl). So the sulfonyl chloride would be attached to the second phenyl: c2ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc2. Then react with aniline (para-methyl phenyl amine) to give sulfonamide linking both phenyls. So step1: sulfonyl chloride + aniline -> sulfonamide product (target). So we need both precursors commercially available.

Check buyability: we have aniline with methyl: Cc1ccc(N)cc1 (p-toluidine) is buyable (True). Sulfonyl chloride: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(C=CC(=O)Cl)cc1? Wait we need sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl that also has the unsaturated amide side chain. Actually the second phenyl has substituent /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N at para position relative to sulfonyl? The SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group. So sulfonyl chloride would be O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc1. Need to check buyability. Likely not common. Could we instead break the amide formation: the α,β-unsaturated amide could be formed via condensation of cinnamaldehyde derivative with aniline? Actually amide formation from acid chloride and aniline. So we could disconnect the amide: the fragment C=CC(=O)N-aryl (aniline) could be formed from acid chloride (C=CC(=O)Cl) and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). The acid chloride is cinnamoyl chloride (trans-3-phenylacryloyl chloride). That's maybe commercially available? Possibly not cheap but maybe.

Alternative: break the C=C double bond via Heck? Might be more complex.

Goal: <=3 steps. Could do two disconnections: 1) sulfonamide formation, 2) amide formation. So three steps total: step1: start from p-toluidine and sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride with unsaturated amide side chain). Step2: the sulfonyl chloride is made from sulfonic acid (aryl sulfonic acid) chlorination (SO2Cl). But we can maybe get sulfonyl chloride directly commercially? Might be not. Could instead get sulfonic acid (aryl sulfonic acid) and convert to sulfonyl chloride (via SOCl2) but that's extra step.

Maybe we can use sulfonyl chloride commercially: p-tolylsulfonyl chloride is common, but we need the other phenyl with side chain. Might not be available.

Alternative route: first form amide between cinnamoyl chloride and aniline (para-aminophenyl). That gives C=CC(=O)Nc3ccccc3N (para-aminophenyl). Then sulfonylate that amine with p-toluenesulfonyl chloride (p-tolylsulfonyl chloride) to give sulfonamide linking p-tolyl to the aniline. That matches target: p-tolyl sulfonyl attached to aniline which also has the amide side chain. Yes! So we need p-toluenesulfonyl chloride (commercial) and cinnamoyl chloride (commercial) and para-aminophenyl (aniline) maybe? Wait the amide formation uses aniline (Nc3ccccc3N) which is p-aminophenyl? Actually the aniline is aniline (c3ccccc3N). That's just aniline (no methyl). That's commercially available. So route:

Step1 (retrosynthesis): target -> sulfonyl chloride (p-toluenesulfonyl chloride) + amide-containing aniline (C=CC(=O)Nc3ccccc3N). That's sulfonamide formation.

Step2: amide-containing aniline can be formed from cinnamoyl chloride (C=CC(=O)Cl) + aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). That's amide formation.

Thus leaves: p-toluenesulfonyl chloride (SMILES: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(C)cc1), cinnamoyl chloride (SMILES: C=CC(=O)Cl), aniline (SMILES: Nc1ccccc1). All likely buyable.

Check buyability: let's test.
